shipping: Free standard shipping on orders over $60 in the US and EU (2-4 business days). Orders under $60: $6.90. Express (1-2 business days): $14.90. Orders placed before 2 pm ET on business days ship the same day. Espresso machines ship insured, signature required.
returns: 30-day returns on unused items in original packaging; we email a prepaid label. Opened coffee beans cannot be returned, but if you don't like a coffee we replace it once for free. Espresso machines and grinders that were used can be returned within 30 days for a 10% restocking fee. Refunds are processed within 3 business days after the return arrives.
warranty: Espresso machines: 2 years (Lume Duo: 3 years). Grinders: 2 years (Trek Hand Grinder: 5 years). Kettles and scales: 1-2 years as listed on each product. Warranty covers manufacturing defects; we repair or replace and pay shipping both ways. Register your machine at aerolume.example/warranty.
subscription: Roaster's Choice subscription: $15 per 250 g bag, free shipping, every 2 or 4 weeks. Skip, pause or cancel any time from your account before the next roast date (Mondays). No minimum commitment.
payment: We accept Visa, Mastercard, Amex, PayPal, Apple Pay and Google Pay. Pay in 4 interest-free installments with Klarna on orders over $150. Prices include VAT for EU customers.
price_match: We match a lower advertised price from authorised retailers in the US and EU within 14 days of purchase. Send a link to support and we refund the difference.
